in_arabic.name: كَمْرَاح
in_arabic.long_meaning: كَمْرَاح: بَيتُ الرَحلِ وَمَوضعُ العَرشِ وَمِن أسماءِ الرُّؤوسِ في القُرآنِ. يُعنى بالحَصنِ المَنصوبِ في كَفّ السيفِ وَبُعدَهُ عن العدوّ. ويَعني الحُرّ المُتَمتعُ بالرِحلةِ العليا. وَكَمْرَاحُ الرُّؤوسِ: رأسُ الحَمامِ. وَكَمَرٌ: القَنا. وَراحُ القَنا: المَوقِفُ في الرِحلةِ

in_urdu.name: کمراہ
in_urdu.meaning: رہائش گاہ، رخصت وصول کی جگہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: کمراہ رہائش گاہ، رخصت وصول کی جگہ، اور قرآن میں رؤس کی ناموں میں سے ہے۔ اسے سيف کے کف میں نصب ہونے والا حصہ اور دشمن سے دورگی کا نام دیا جاتا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے کہ وہ شخص جس کے پاس سافٹ سفر کی اجازت ہے۔ اور کمراہ رؤس کے ساتھ رہائش گاہ کا نام ہے۔ اور کمر کے معنی ہیں قنا، اور رحال قنا کے قیام کا مقام ہے

in_hindi.name: कमराह
in_hindi.meaning: रहायश गाह, रिख़्सित वसल की जगह
in_hindi.long_meaning: कमराह रहायश गाह, रिख़्सित वसल की जगह, और कुरआन में रूस के नामों में से है। इसे सेफ़ के कफ़ में निस्बित होने वाला हिस्सा और दुश्मन से दूरी का नाम दिया जाता है। इसका अर्थ है वह व्यक्ति जिसके पास सॉफ्ट यात्रा की अनुमति है। और कमराह रूस के साथ रहायश गाह का नाम है। और कमर के अर्थ हैं कोना, और रहाल कोना के निवास का स्थान है।

in_pashto.name: کمراہ
in_pashto.long_meaning: کمراہ ځای، پټه لوټ، او په قران کې رؤس کي نومونه کي جوړوي. دا په سيف کي پټه لوټ کا نوم دیو. دا سړي کا نوم دیو چې تاسو به سوله سره سفر کوي. او کمراہ رؤس کي سره ځای کا نوم دیو. او کمر کا معنا کونډه. او رهایل کا معنا کونډه کا ځای دیو

in_english.long_meaning: Kamraah is a name that refers to a place of rest, a place of refuge, and a safe haven. In Arabic, it is derived from the root KMR, which means 'to rest' or 'to be at peace'. In Islamic tradition, it is associated with the idea of a safe haven or a place of refuge, where one can rest and feel secure. In Quranic contexts, it is mentioned as one of the names of the heads or the leaders. The name Kamraah is also associated with the idea of a place of residence or a dwelling place, where one can rest and live in peace.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Kamraah" holds a beautiful meaning derived from the Arabic language, which is deeply rooted in Muslim culture. Arabic names, rich in linguistic depth and poetic quality, have long been an essential aspect of Islamic identity. The name "Kamraah" signifies a connection to the natural world and particularly to the captivating and alluring blooms of jasmine flowers. These flowers have long been a source of inspiration in Islamic literature and art, representing the essence of beauty, love, and romance. Therefore, a child named Kamraah would be deeply connected to this admirably beautiful heritage and would carry an image of sophistication, dignity, and enchantment.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Kamraah," reflecting the meaning of 'jasmine', also holds significant spiritual significance for Muslims. In Islamic traditions, flowers and gardens symbolize paradise, where the believers will be welcomed with eternal beauty, joy, and human connection. The jasmine flower, in particular, is an embodiment of such spiritually evocative symbols. Its fragrance is believed to be reminiscent of the sweet aroma of paradise. The use of floral imagery, including jasmine, is prominent in various Islamic texts and poetic expressions, such as the Quran and Hadiths, and the literary works of renowned Persian and Arabic poets. Thus, naming an individual "Kamraah" would be a constant reminder of the connection between the earthly realm and the divine one and a call to live life in search of the eternal beauty promised in paradise.
